result:
I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Layout:** The 1280px screen is inside `#component`. The "New request" heading and a white card sit on 8 of the 12 columns, with 64px margins and 32px gutters. The page background is the pale blue Sand. Title and Description each take a full row. Priority, Assignee and Due date share one row. Cancel and Create Request sit at the bottom right.
- **Design file:** I used only its colors, type sizes, spacing, radii and letter-spacing. The heading is Unbounded Light in all caps at 56px, and the labels are 12px caps in the accent blue. Cancel has no fill and Create Request is a black pill.
- **Fonts:** There are no font files in the folder, so Unbounded and Archivo only show if they're installed on the machine. Otherwise it falls back to Helvetica or Arial.
- **Assignee:** It starts on a blank option so nobody is assigned by default. Priority starts on Medium.
